mission.name: InterestShield Original-Vision Production Restoration
mission.tagline: Recognizable assets, conserved cash, trustworthy comparisons. Task progress is not production readiness.
mission.northStar: Truth-first, hope-forward Velocity Banking education with correct math, explicit assumptions, private owner-scoped data, calm coaching, and no promised outcomes.

policies.notes: User approved autonomous implementation, verified pushes and recurring work. PR #256 stays draft while required production gates remain open. Do not auto-deploy, broaden access, start paid GPU jobs or mutate production data. Keep future implementation slices focused.

phases.title: Scenario and Calculation Coherence
phases.goal: Dashboard, Portfolio, Vault and Expo use consistent scenarios and budget/liability contracts.

tasks.title: Safely unify scenario ownership without overwriting saved household data
Complete equal-budget equal-liability strategy comparisons
tasks.notes: Web/Expo Simulator now shares direct repayment with the same active debt, existing LOC and available budget. Cash at each payoff and adverse signed deltas are visible. 275 regressions, 78 closed-form cases and six actual-browser cases pass; independent review found no blocking financial defect. Mortgage/Vault-web, Portfolio, dashboard helpers, actual lender/calendar integration and Velocity final-payment/zero-surplus edges remain open.

tasks.title: Implement or remove ineffective chunk-frequency controls
tasks.notes: chunkFrequency is persisted but not consumed by the web simulator; Guardian copy still suggests unsupported timing comparisons. Mortgage paymentFrequency buttons also have no corresponding read in calculation logic. Remove or clearly label unsupported choices until the dated ledger contract is wired; preserve saved data.

gates.title: Financial regressions
gates.notes: Local branch regressions pass. This does not complete cross-route coherence or lender integration.

gates.title: Independent reference scenarios
gates.notes: Two anonymized fixtures and 78 independent closed-form comparison cases. Fixtures are not actual lender quotes.

gates.title: Rendered Simulator comparison edge cases
gates.notes: Three scenarios at 1440px and 375px: two liabilities, slower/higher-interest Velocity, unaffordable payments; visible bars, empty state, signed badges, no page overflow/errors. CI uploads actual screenshots.

tasks.title: Verify dedicated Supabase environment and owner-scoped persistence
tasks.notes: Cloud access is now available. The similarly named healthy Velocity Banking candidate has zero public tables and zero applied migrations. tasks.notes: 60ab957 patches Next/ESLint to 16.4.2 and PostCSS to 8.5.31. Runtime audit zero; build, lint, regressions, seven rendered routes, all ten software-rendered heroes, failure paths and standalone Money Loop proof passed locally. Independent patch review clear. Final exact-head hosted CI remains required; live production is not updated.
